name: io.github.prspktvs/suomi-mcp
title: AgentFinland Finnish Statistics
description: Find, inspect, and retrieve official Finnish statistics from multiple publishers.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_REGISTRY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted discovery catalog origin; defaults to https://agentfinland.fi.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional key for a higher catalog rate limit.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of enabled publisher IDs.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_HELSINKI
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the enabled-by-default beta Helsinki HTML-form provider.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional schema and catalog metadata cache directory; set to off to disable disk caching.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_MAX_CELLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum cells in one publisher query, from 1 to 120000.

environmentVariables.name: SUOMI_MCP_SQL_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to node, wasm, or auto.
